units.poolKey: COMBINATION C4: a low rung on a working approach
units.spine: The roads in are busy and the place at the end of them is poor.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: One trade brings in the money here, and every other living comes out of it.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: Goods leave this place and goods come into it on the same carts.
Warmholz sells several things outward and leans on none of them alone.
The place feeds itself and keeps a little in hand.
Salt is worked here, and all of it is bought before it is worked.
